facts.fact: NCC state-by-state data shows 101,148.36 km of fibre deployed nationwide; NCC's executive vice chairman calls it about 101,000 km of fibre optic backbone. Figure counts all fibre (Lagos and FCT hold 18.35%), date given as the article's publication date.

Article says the 101,000 km network stretches across all 36 states and the FCT; NCC state data lists fibre in every state (lowest Ebonyi 586.92 km, Bayelsa 656.87 km). Date is the article's publication date.

note: Figures are total fibre, not only capital-to-region backbone; Project BRIDGE is a plan.
